messages:
maya: FYI customer acct_9f2 flagged an invoice where billed tokens >> dashboard tokens for last week. They say it only happens when using streaming responses (SSE) and midstream disconnects. attaching a short excerpt.
sam: Can you paste the customer request id(s)? need to trace metering records vs billing ledger.
maya: request ids: rQ-4456, rQ-4460. They reported a client cancel halfway through and then reconnected. Quote from customer: 'we see ~2.1M tokens billed, dashboard shows 0.9M for same date range' :thinking:
jin: @maya thanks. are these using the chunked streaming option or partial generations? any content length hints?
maya: They use streaming with streaming_token=true in SDK, chunk sizes vary. Typical streams end with a final chunk containing "[DONE]" but in a few traces the client TCP closed before final chunk.
emma: Do we have any meter-bot events for those request ids?
billing-bot: Reconciliation task report attached: invoice_delta > threshold for acct_9f2 on 2026-11-04. Candidate upstream streams without final ACK: count=23, avg_extra_billed_tokens=~4200.
sam: That suggests we might be double-counting partial shards when client reconnects and we re-stream missing suffix. Need raw metering lines. @jin can you pull the metering entries and the SSE delivery log for rQ-4456?
jin: grabbing logs now. here's the streaming tail for rQ-4456 (redacted):
```
[2026-11-04T18:12:03Z] serve: request=rQ-4456 start
[2026-11-04T18:12:03Z] stream: chunk_id=1 tokens=1800
[2026-11-04T18:12:03Z] stream: chunk_id=2 tokens=1600
[2026-11-04T18:12:04Z] connection: client closed (RST)
[2026-11-04T18:12:04Z] stream: cached_kv persisted
[2026-11-04T18:12:04Z] serve: request=rQ-4456 end status=client_cancelled
[2026-11-04T18:12:05Z] serve: request=rQ-4456 resume attempt
[2026-11-04T18:12:05Z] stream: chunk_id=2 tokens=1600 (replayed)
[2026-11-04T18:12:06Z] stream: chunk_id=3 tokens=2100
[2026-11-04T18:12:06Z] stream: final_chunk tokens=100
```
maya: important bit is the replay of chunk_id=2 after resume. metering shows chunk 2 counted twice in some ledger rows.
sam: do we store tokens per chunk atomically? is there dedupe by chunk_id and request_id?
jin: current metering writes token events on chunk emission to billing queue. if client disconnects we still flush emitted chunks. when resume happens we replay cached chunks and emit them again; there's no global dedupe because resumed stream looks like a new emission at runtime. we do have request_id but resume uses same request_id in the traces above, odd.
emma: resume path should set resume_token or a resume_sequence to avoid re-emitting already-billed tokens. sounds like resume didn't set a replay flag.
jin: root cause candidate: when the client reconnect path hit a code path introduced in runtime v1.14 (hotfix) that re-emits cached chunks without marking them as replayed. pushing a patch to add an idempotency marker.
maya: customer wants an ETA on credit or fix. Can we calculate net overbill per account to issue credits?
sam: I'll run a delta job for acct_9f2 once jin attaches a list of duplicate chunk events. Need a CSV: request_id, chunk_id, token_count, event_ts (billing queue).
jin: attaching a quick grep output (abridged):
```
rQ-4456,2,1600,2026-11-04T18:12:03Z
rQ-4456,2,1600,2026-11-04T18:12:05Z
rQ-4460,5,2400,2026-11-04T19:01:10Z
rQ-4460,5,2400,2026-11-04T19:01:12Z
```
sam: perfect. I'll compute credits = sum(duplicate_token_counts) * per_token_rate and prepare a credit note.
emma: deploy-bot triggered on the candidate patch?
deploy-bot: rollout started for runtime v1.14.1 (idempotency markers for stream-replay). canary on 10% infra.
jin: patch adds a `replayed=true` flag to billing events and drops writes when event with same (request_id, chunk_id, replayed=false) already exists. tests added.
maya: thanks. action items: 1) sam to compute credits and notify customer support 2) jin to finish deploy and confirm canary telemetry for duplicate events drops 3) maya to follow up with customer and share repro steps. :thumbsup:
sam: will send credit estimate by EOD.
jin: monitoring note: adding a dashboard tile for "duplicate stream billing events" with alert if rate > 0.1% of stream requests.
emma: also adding a short doc in docs/streaming_reconnects.md to outline resume semantics and recommended client behavior (use resume_token, explicit ACK).
maya: customer update queued. closing loop once sam confirms credits.
